name: modernize a legacy c++ codebase to compile on a modern toolchain
definition: adapt an old platform-specific C++ library so it builds and runs on the current system by fixing obsolete or Windows-era APIs and porting them to the host compiler.
failure_mode: compilation errors from obsolete language/API usage prevent any executable from being produced

name: plan obstacle-aware movement with elevation constraints and stackable block manipulation
definition: Navigate a grid while respecting per-cell elevation limits and the ability to pick up and drop blocks, choosing actions to traverse or build paths.
failure_mode: Agent gets stuck on walls/elevation or mishandles pickup/drop, failing to reach the goal.
